question: Should this PR's new Android provider-config model view and Gateway protocol value be accepted after the compatibility fallback, ktlint fix, and current-head proof are added?
rationale: The branch adds a new user-visible Android management surface and Gateway protocol view, so implementation quality is separate from maintainer acceptance of the product/API direction.

options.title: Accept After Blockers
options.body: Proceed with this direction only after Android handles older Gateway fallback, the current-head read-only proof is posted, and ktlint is fixed.

options.title: Require Same-Version Gateway
options.body: Accept the version-skew failure intentionally, which would leave older Gateway users with an error state on this screen.

options.title: Decline Core Surface
options.body: Close or pause the PR until provider-model review is sponsored as a broader Android/Gateway product direction.

recommendation.title: Accept After Blockers
recommendation.body: Proceed with this direction only after Android handles older Gateway fallback, the current-head read-only proof is posted, and ktlint is fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: The Android provider readiness screen history points to this owner signal as the closest product-surface routing candidate.
